title: Puzzle 5d Suggestion Parity
description: Puzzle 5d must show brush suggestions on grips like puzzle 2d and 3d. Unified kind catalogs must carry per-part-kind grip templates and meshUrl, merge 2d and 3d source metas, and project back to embedded canvases.
summary:
Fixed infinite update loop in Puzzle5dBrushPairedSync.

Root cause: flat→volume sync called applyCandidateIndex which notified volume engagement epoch; volume→flat sync called puzzle2dApplyBrushSuggestionsCandidateIndex which re-notified flat session — ping-pong without idempotency checks.

Fix:
- Semantic mirror keys compare flat session vs volume preview before syncing either direction
- Skip volume→flat candidate apply when candidateIndex already matches
- Skip 3d applyCandidateIndex/applyBootstrapPreview when preview candidate unchanged
- syncFromFlat early return when 3d preview already mirrors incoming candidate
- Only clear volume brush when flat session ends and a preview is still showing
